$comment: Where the skill store looks. Marvi never installs from a source she discovered herself - not from a link in a page, not from a model's suggestion. This list is the list, and it is yours to edit. Every repository here was checked to actually serve SKILL.md directories; several well-known 'awesome' lists are READMEs pointing elsewhere and return nothing, and marketplaces that index by occupation are generated rather than written.

sources.name: Anthropic
sources.description: The official Agent Skills repository. Documents, spreadsheets, slides, and skill-creator.

sources.name: Superpowers
sources.description: How to work rather than what to know: brainstorming, systematic debugging, verification before claiming done.

sources.name: Browser Use
sources.description: Driving a real browser - the tool Marvi already has, with the practice for using it well.

sources.name: Science
sources.description: 163 skills across biology, chemistry, astronomy, statistics and medicine, plus scientific databases.

sources.name: Assistant work (michaelboeding)
sources.description: Research, brand and competitor analysis, charts, audio and image work. Closest thing to a personal-assistant collection.

sources.name: Anthropic Cookbooks
sources.description: Worked examples: financial statements, financial models, brand guidelines.

sources.name: OpenAI
sources.description: Codex's own skills. Development-focused, and useful for working on Marvi herself.

sources.name: Community (wshobson)
sources.description: The largest community collection. Engineering practice: Python, testing, security, incident write-ups.

sources.name: Cloudflare
sources.description: Cloudflare's own: Workers, Durable Objects, email routing.
